title: Title Operations Standard: Lien Release for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Contracts
content:
**Title Operations standard — lien release on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

The lien can be released only when the contract status is paid in full.

**Hold on personal funds.** When the funds that brought the balance to zero were a personal check or an ACH debit, the lien may be released no earlier than the lien release hold, in business days, after the balance reached zero. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding US federal holidays, counted from the first business day after the paid-in-full date, and release on the last day of the hold is permitted. Payoffs by cashier's check, wire, dealer, lender or insurer remittance carry no hold.

**Release method.** Where the lien is electronic, it is released electronically to the title state within the electronic release period in business days; where the title is paper, the title is signed off and mailed within the paper title mailing period in business days.

**Recipient.** The recipient follows how the contract was paid off: a refinance lender payoff goes to the new lienholder, a dealer trade-in payoff to the dealer, an insurance total loss payoff to the insurer, and every other payoff to the customer. A paper title may be mailed to an address other than the address on file only after the customer has completed a signed alternate-address title release request.

**Closing.** Once the release is completed the title status is updated and the account is closed.

### Hold boundary (hypothetical, 10-business-day hold, no holidays in the period)

A personal-check payoff brings the balance to zero on a Friday. The first business day after is the Monday (day 1); the tenth business day is the Friday of the following week. Release is permitted on that Friday, the last day of the hold, and not on the Thursday before it.

### Recipient table

| Payoff | Title or release goes to |
|---|---|
| Refinance lender | the new lienholder |
| Dealer trade-in | the dealer |
| Insurance total loss | the insurer |
| Any other payoff | the customer |
